entities.summary: Naum Ikhilievich Kleiman is a historian of cinema, Russian film critic, specialist in Sergei Eisenstein, former manager of the Moscow State Central Cinema Museum, Eisenstein-Centre director, actor and filmmaker. He was a member of the jury at the 43rd Berlin International Film Festival in 1993 and a member of the jury at the Venice Film Festival in 1991. He is a FIPRESCI laureate. Naum Kleiman was a journalists & chroniclers from Chișinău (b. 1937-12-01, Chișinău). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
